agent_notes: Normal TLS was attempted first. Google, Bing, and spsu.ac.in produced the exact managed-proxy self-signed certificate-chain error, so public GETs used --insecure only after hostname confirmation.
The official site spells the university name Padampat, while the supplied NIRF name uses Padmapat; SPSU, Udaipur, and the official campus address establish the identity match.
The current Apply Now page was modified 2026-09-08 and was used for the current programme list, duration, and eligibility; the Explore Programs page and doctoral page were cross-checked.
The official site contains a legacy duplicate eligibility block with older 2022 data; it was excluded in favor of the current 2026 section.
The Management Development Programme page is an explicitly dated 22-24 September 2023 residential event, so it was excluded as an expired short-term event.
No active diploma or certificate programme was established in the current catalogue.
